edit.description: readConsumerManifest refuses a non-object dependencies/devDependencies in the pre-write phase; addDependency stops reading one
refusal cases beside the existing non-object-manifest one; dependency-outcome pins

summary: init silently mangles a consumer manifest whose dependencies field is not an object — refuse it before the first byte, per Loud or nothing
acceptance: harnessInit throws in flume's voice naming the manifest and the offending field, before any write, when dependencies or devDependencies is present and not a JSON object; no arm of addDependency reads a non-object off pkg.
tests: flume-harness init refuses a consumer package.json whose dependencies field is not an object before writing anything
flume-harness init refuses a consumer package.json whose devDependencies field is not an object before writing anything
pins: flume-harness init reports the dependency line it added to the consumer's manifest
flume-harness init reports a dependency the consumer's manifest already declares without rewriting its range
notes: Measured this tick at harness/init.ts:508-516: dependencies "oops" rewrites the consumer manifest to {"0":"o","1":"o","2":"p","3":"s","@dtmd/flume":"^0.15.0"} and reports kind "added"; dependencies 42 drops the field. Same defect readConsumerManifest's own doc names one level up, unrefused one level down.
